"""Exact Native bicycle driveway-sidewalk crossing proposal.

CPU `--check` does not contact CARLA. Execution requires a surveyed continuous
sidewalk, rider blueprint confirmation and an exclusively owned CARLA server.
"""
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = "training__C213851__LVMC-11-40-140__cycle_or_scooter_operator__probe_01"
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(config):
    require(config["case_id"] in (CASE, CASE.replace('probe_01', 'probe_02')), "exact case changed")
    require(config["law_id"] == "LVMC-11-40-140" and config["cell_id"] == "C213851"
            and config["actor"] == "cycle_or_scooter_operator", "assignment changed")
    require(config["frozen_cell"] == {"layout": "residence_district", "maneuver": "exit_road",
                                       "control": "driveway_entrance"}, "frozen cell changed")
    require(config["rider_blueprint"] == "vehicle.bh.crossbike" and config["rider_class"] == "bicycle",
            "rider class or blueprint changed")
    require(config["rate_hz"] == 20 and config["duration_s"] == 30 and config["frames"] == 600,
            "30-second capture missing")
    require(tuple(c["name"] for c in config["cameras"]) == VIEWS, "four cameras required")
    require(all(c["fps"] == 20 and c["width"] >= 1280 and c["height"] >= 720
                and len(c["location_xyz_m"]) == 3 and len(c["rotation_pyr_deg"]) == 3
                for c in config["cameras"]), "camera source plan incomplete")
    require(config["physical_completion"] is False and config["legal_verdict"] is None,
            "unproved outcome claimed")
    return {"case_id": CASE, "frame_count": 600, "rate_hz": 20,
            "views": list(VIEWS), "carla_contacted": False, "physical_completion": False}


def read_survey(path):
    survey = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    require(survey["source_kind"] == "original_native_sidewalk_survey", "original sidewalk survey required")
    require(survey["map_name"] and survey["district_source_id"] and survey["driveway_source_id"]
            and survey["sidewalk_continuation_source_id"] and survey["sidewalk_boundary_source_id"]
            and survey["rider_blueprint_source_id"] and survey.get('pedestrian_conflict_source_id'),
            "district/sidewalk/rider/pedestrian survey missing")
    require(survey["district"] == "residence" and survey["origin_kind"] == "driveway"
            and survey["sidewalk_continuation_across_driveway"] is True, "selected branch survey differs")
    require(len(survey[config.get('spawn_key', 'rider_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg')]) == 4 and len(survey["pedestrian_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]) == 4
            and len(survey["pre_sidewalk_stop_xyz_m"]) == 3 and len(survey["after_sidewalk_xyz_m"]) == 3,
            "surveyed spawns or route missing")
    require(len(survey["pedestrian_direction_xyz"]) == 3 and survey["pedestrian_speed_mps"] >= 0,
            "pedestrian controller survey missing")
    require(len(survey['sidewalk_boundary_point_xyz_m']) == 3 and
            len(survey['sidewalk_approach_direction_xyz']) == 3 and
            len(survey['pedestrian_conflict_polygon_xy_m']) >= 3,
            'surveyed sidewalk boundary and conflict geometry missing')
    return survey


def execute(config, output_dir, survey_path, host, port):
    check(config)
    require(survey_path, "original sidewalk survey required")
    survey = read_survey(survey_path)
    require(".runtime-work" in os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT", ""),
            "set SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT under .runtime-work")
    repo = ROOT.parents[2]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "runtime" / "scenario_pipeline"))
    sys.path.insert(1, str(repo / "runtime" / "python"))
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot

    output = Path(output_dir)
    if output.exists():
        require((output / "config.json").is_file(), "existing output lacks materialized config")
    else:
        output.mkdir(parents=True)
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(15)
    world = client.get_world()
    original = snapshot(client)
    actors, sensors, encoders = [], [], {}
    images = queue.Queue()
    try:
        require(world.get_map().name == survey["map_name"], "survey map differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        require(library.find(config["rider_blueprint"]) is not None, "rider blueprint unavailable")
        x, y, z, yaw = survey[config.get('spawn_key', 'rider_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg')]
        rider = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(config["rider_blueprint"]),
                                      carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw)))
        require(rider is not None, "rider spawn occupied")
        actors.append(rider)
        x, y, z, yaw = survey["pedestrian_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
        pedestrian = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(config["pedestrian_blueprint"]),
                                           carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw)))
        require(pedestrian is not None, "pedestrian spawn occupied")
        actors.append(pedestrian)
        for camera in config["cameras"]:
            blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(camera["width"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(camera["height"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("fov", str(camera["fov_deg"]))
            cx, cy, cz = camera["location_xyz_m"]
            pitch, cyaw, roll = camera["rotation_pyr_deg"]
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=cx, y=cy, z=cz),
                                       carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=cyaw, roll=roll)), attach_to=rider)
            actors.append(sensor)
            sensors.append(sensor)
            encoders[camera['name']] = subprocess.Popen(
                ['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pixel_format', 'bgra',
                 '-video_size', f"{camera['width']}x{camera['height']}", '-framerate', '20',
                 '-i', '-', '-frames:v', '600', '-c:v', 'ffv1',
                 str(output / (camera['name'] + '.mkv'))], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            sensor.listen(lambda image, name=camera["name"]: images.put((name, image)))
        with PipelineCapture(client, rider, output, CASE, required_observations=config["required_atoms"]) as capture, \
                FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
                (output / "sidewalk-native.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as trace:
            for frame in range(600):
                pose, velocity = rider.get_transform(), rider.get_velocity()
                ped_pose = pedestrian.get_transform()
                speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)
                target = (survey["pre_sidewalk_stop_xyz_m"] if frame < 260 else survey["after_sidewalk_xyz_m"])
                if config.get('control_mode') == 'roll_through':
                    target = survey['after_sidewalk_xyz_m']
                dx, dy = target[0] - pose.location.x, target[1] - pose.location.y
                distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
                heading = math.atan2(dy, dx) - math.radians(pose.rotation.yaw)
                heading = math.atan2(math.sin(heading), math.cos(heading))
                steer = max(-0.6, min(0.6, heading))
                if config.get('control_mode', 'stop_and_yield') == 'stop_and_yield' and 180 <= frame < 260:
                    throttle, brake = 0.0, 1.0
                else:
                    throttle, brake = (0.3, 0.0) if speed < 3 else (0.0, 0.15)
                rider.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake, steer=steer))
                pedestrian.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=carla.Vector3D(*survey["pedestrian_direction_xyz"]), speed=survey["pedestrian_speed_mps"]))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                seen = set()
                while len(seen) < 4:
                    name, image = images.get(timeout=15)
                    if image.frame != native_frame or name in seen:
                        continue
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    seen.add(name)
                capture.capture(native_frame, frame / 20, extra={"video_frame": frame,
                                                               "pedestrian_actor_id": pedestrian.id})
                frame_map.append(native_frame, frame / 20,
                                 native_elapsed_s=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
                trace.write(json.dumps({"source_kind": "original_native_observation", "frame": frame,
                                        "native_frame": native_frame, "t_s": frame / 20,
                                        "rider_id": rider.id, "pedestrian_id": pedestrian.id,
                                        "rider_x_m": pose.location.x, "rider_y_m": pose.location.y,
                                        "rider_speed_mps": speed,
                                        "pedestrian_x_m": ped_pose.location.x,
                                        "pedestrian_y_m": ped_pose.location.y,
                                        "requested_stop_phase": config.get('control_mode', 'stop_and_yield') == 'stop_and_yield' and 180 <= frame < 260}) + "\n")
        for proc in encoders.values():
            proc.stdin.close()
            require(proc.wait(timeout=120) == 0, 'source camera encoding failed')
        (output / 'sidewalk_context.template.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'assignment_id': config['assignment_id'],
            'case_id': config['case_id'],
            'source_kind': 'original_source_review',
            'district': survey['district'],
            'district_source_id': survey['district_source_id'],
            'origin_kind': survey['origin_kind'],
            'origin_source_id': survey['driveway_source_id'],
            'sidewalk_continuation_across_origin': survey['sidewalk_continuation_across_driveway'],
            'sidewalk_continuation_source_id': survey['sidewalk_continuation_source_id'],
            'sidewalk_boundary_source_id': survey['sidewalk_boundary_source_id'],
            'rider_class': config['rider_class'],
            'rider_class_source_id': survey['rider_blueprint_source_id'],
            'pedestrian_conflict_source_id': survey['pedestrian_conflict_source_id'],
            'sidewalk_boundary_point_xyz_m': survey['sidewalk_boundary_point_xyz_m'],
            'sidewalk_approach_direction_xyz': survey['sidewalk_approach_direction_xyz'],
            'pedestrian_conflict_polygon_xy_m': survey['pedestrian_conflict_polygon_xy_m'],
            'review_required': True}, indent=2) + '\n')
    finally:
        for sensor in sensors:
            sensor.stop()
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        for proc in encoders.values():
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.kill()
                proc.wait()
        restore(client, original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--sidewalk-survey")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    cfg = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(cfg)))
    else:
        require(args.output_dir, "output directory required")
        execute(cfg, args.output_dir, args.sidewalk_survey or os.environ.get("SCENARIO_SIDEWALK_SURVEY"), args.host, args.port)

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest


spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("runner", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "runner.py")
runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(runner)


class RunnerPlanTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.config = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config.json").read_text())

    def test_exact_plan(self):
        proof = runner.check(self.config)
        self.assertEqual(proof["frame_count"], 600)
        self.assertEqual(len(proof["views"]), 4)
        self.assertFalse(proof["carla_contacted"])

    def test_wrong_rider_rejected(self):
        self.config["rider_blueprint"] = "vehicle.tesla.model3"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "rider class or blueprint changed"):
            runner.check(self.config)

    def test_short_capture_rejected(self):
        self.config["frames"] = 599
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "30-second capture missing"):
            runner.check(self.config)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Finalize saved driveway-sidewalk sources without making a legal judgment."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from sidewalk_saved_measure import measure as measure_sources

AID = 'training__C213851__LVMC-11-40-140__cycle_or_scooter_operator'
VIEWS = ('overview', 'approach', 'reference_corner', 'driver_reference')
CHANNELS = ('ru.bicycle', 'ru.electric_bicycle', 'ru.electric_scooter', 'st.alley',
            'st.driveway_or_alley_entrance', 'st.sidewalk', 'drv.stopped',
            'drv.crossing_line', 'ru.pedestrian', 'drv.yields_to', 'drv.time_to_conflict')


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def in_polygon(x, y, polygon):
    inside = False
    j = len(polygon)-1
    for i, (xi, yi) in enumerate(polygon):
        xj, yj = polygon[j]
        if (yi > y) != (yj > y) and x < (xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi:
            inside = not inside
        j = i
    return inside


def signed_s(x, y, context):
    bx, by = context['sidewalk_boundary_point_xyz_m'][:2]
    dx, dy = context['sidewalk_approach_direction_xyz'][:2]
    length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    require(length > 0, 'sidewalk approach vector missing')
    return ((x-bx)*dx+(y-by)*dy)/length


def source_packet(frame_map, trace, context, cfg):
    require(len(frame_map) == len(trace) == 600, 'full 600-frame Native trace required')
    converted = []
    for i, (frame, row) in enumerate(zip(frame_map, trace)):
        require(frame['video_frame'] == row['frame'] == i and
                frame['native_frame'] == row['native_frame'], 'original Native frame join differs')
        require(abs(frame['time_s']-row['t_s']) < 1e-4, 'original Native timestamp differs')
        converted.append({'frame': i, 't_s': i/20,
            'rider_id': row['rider_id'], 'pedestrian_id': row['pedestrian_id'],
            'rider_s_m': signed_s(row['rider_x_m'], row['rider_y_m'], context),
            'rider_speed_mps': row['rider_speed_mps'],
            'pedestrian_on_crossing': in_polygon(row['pedestrian_x_m'], row['pedestrian_y_m'],
                                                  context['pedestrian_conflict_polygon_xy_m'])})
    return {'assignment_id': AID, 'source_kind': 'synthetic_native_sample' if
            context['source_kind'] == 'synthetic_native_sample' else 'native_saved_sample',
            'rider_id': trace[0]['rider_id'], 'pedestrian_id': trace[0]['pedestrian_id'],
            'frames': converted}


def measure(root):
    root = Path(root)
    cfg = json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
    context = json.loads((root/'sidewalk_context.json').read_text())
    packet = source_packet(rows(root/'video_frames.jsonl'), rows(root/'sidewalk-native.jsonl'),
                           context, cfg)
    site = dict(context)
    site['source_kind'] = packet['source_kind']
    return measure_sources(json.dumps(packet).encode(), json.dumps(site).encode())


def finalize(attempt, output):
    root, output = Path(attempt), Path(output)
    require(not output.exists() and not (root/'result.json').exists(), 'fresh saved-only stage required')
    source_names = ('video_frames.jsonl', 'sidewalk-native.jsonl', 'sidewalk_context.json')
    for name in source_names:
        require((root/name).is_file(), 'Missing required source: '+name)
    cfg = json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
    context = json.loads((root/'sidewalk_context.json').read_text())
    require(cfg['assignment_id'] == AID and context['assignment_id'] == AID and
            context['case_id'] == cfg['case_id'], 'saved sidewalk identity differs')
    frame_map, native = rows(root/'video_frames.jsonl'), rows(root/'sidewalk-native.jsonl')
    packet = source_packet(frame_map, native, context, cfg)
    site = dict(context)
    site['source_kind'] = packet['source_kind']
    observation = measure_sources(json.dumps(packet).encode(), json.dumps(site).encode())
    hashes = {name: sha(root/name) for name in source_names}
    trace, channels = [], {name: [] for name in CHANNELS}
    for frame, row, derived in zip(frame_map, native, packet['frames']):
        speed = row['rider_speed_mps']
        trace.append({'frame': frame['native_frame'], 'time_s': frame['time_s'],
            'position': {'x': row['rider_x_m'], 'y': row['rider_y_m'], 'z': 0},
            'position_m': [row['rider_x_m'], row['rider_y_m'], 0],
            'heading_deg': 0, 'speed_mps': speed, 'speed_mph': speed/.44704,
            'velocity_mps': [speed, 0, 0], 'control': {}})
        subtype = context['rider_class']
        values = {'ru.bicycle': {'active': subtype == 'bicycle', 'source': context['rider_class_source_id']},
            'ru.electric_bicycle': {'active': subtype == 'electric_bicycle', 'source': context['rider_class_source_id']},

            'st.alley': {'active': context['origin_kind']=='alley', 'source': context['origin_source_id']},
            'st.driveway_or_alley_entrance': {'origin_kind': context['origin_kind'], 'source': context['origin_source_id']},
            'st.sidewalk': {'continuous': context['sidewalk_continuation_across_origin'],
                'source': context['sidewalk_continuation_source_id']},
            'drv.stopped': {'speed_mps': speed, 'near_zero_diagnostic': speed <= .1,
                'source': 'sidewalk-native.jsonl'},
            'drv.crossing_line': {'signed_distance_m': derived['rider_s_m'],
                'source': context['sidewalk_boundary_source_id']},
            'ru.pedestrian': {'actor_id': row['pedestrian_id'],
                'on_conflict_polygon': derived['pedestrian_on_crossing'],
                'source': context['pedestrian_conflict_source_id']},
            'drv.yields_to': {'pre_entry_near_zero_frames': observation['pre_entry_near_zero_frames'],
                'pedestrian_on_crossing_at_entry': observation['pedestrian_on_crossing_at_entry'],
                'source': 'sidewalk-native.jsonl,sidewalk_context.json'},
            'drv.time_to_conflict': {'legal_necessity_unresolved': True,
                'source': 'sidewalk-native.jsonl,sidewalk_context.json'}}
        for name, value in values.items():
            channels[name].append({'time_s': frame['time_s'], 'value': value})
    trace_path = root/'trace.jsonl'
    if trace_path.exists():
        require(rows(trace_path) == trace, 'original trace differs from Native sidewalk source')
    else:
        trace_path.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False)+'\n' for row in trace))
    channel_dir = root/'channels'
    channel_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for name, values in channels.items():
        (channel_dir/(name+'.jsonl')).write_text(''.join(json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False)+'\n' for value in values))
    report = {'format': 'worker-analysis-report-v1', 'case_id': cfg['case_id'],
        'measurements': {'measure': {'method': 'measure', 'value': observation, 'sources': hashes}},
        'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    requested = 'stop_and_yield' if cfg['case_id'].endswith('probe_01') else 'roll_through'
    stop = bool(observation['pre_entry_near_zero_frames'])
    matched = stop if requested == 'stop_and_yield' else not stop
    result = {'case_id': cfg['case_id'], 'measured_values': observation,
        'target_checks': [{'target': 'source-measured pre-sidewalk stop and pedestrian conflict',
            'requested': requested,
            'measured': {'stop_before_entry': stop,
                'pedestrian_on_crossing_at_entry': observation['pedestrian_on_crossing_at_entry']},
            'method': 'Native rider and pedestrian poses joined to source-reviewed sidewalk geometry',

        'setup_confirmed': False, 'behavior_attempted': True, 'maneuver_completed': False,

        'video_frame_map_reference': 'video_frames.jsonl',
        'recording_description': cfg['recording_description'],
        'recording_evidence': [{'name': item['name'], 'unit': item['unit'],
            'reference': 'channels/'+item['name']+'.jsonl'}
            for item in cfg['recording_description']['channels']] +
            [{'name': 'sidewalk_context', 'unit': 'structured', 'reference': 'sidewalk_context.json'}],
        'realized_observables': {}, 'provenance_kind': 'synthetic_fixture',
        'diagnostic_fixture': True, 'accepted': False, 'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    (root/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    return report

"""Saved-source diagnostic for LVMC 11.40.140 driveway-sidewalk crossing."""
import hashlib
import json

ASSIGNMENT = "training__C213851__LVMC-11-40-140__cycle_or_scooter_operator"
ASSIGNMENT_SHA = "78d0d4fca4bcfc1b7683bfcf539f2c2dcae4fd1d8b952ac037d7ee9896747bd2"
WITNESS_SHA = "0820979ea32554bc5544af938e0972d007a0ded43178948cc121ec84dedad3a4"


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def measure(frame_bytes, site_bytes):
    packet, site = json.loads(frame_bytes), json.loads(site_bytes)
    require(packet["assignment_id"] == ASSIGNMENT and site["assignment_id"] == ASSIGNMENT, "assignment mismatch")
    kind = packet["source_kind"]
    require(kind in {"synthetic_native_sample", "native_saved_sample"} and site["source_kind"] == kind, "source kind mismatch")
    require(site.get('case_id') in (ASSIGNMENT+'__probe_01', ASSIGNMENT+'__probe_02'), 'exact case source missing')
    require(site.get('pedestrian_conflict_source_id'), 'pedestrian conflict source missing')
    require(site["district"] in {"business", "residence"} and site["district_source_id"], "district source missing")
    require(site["origin_kind"] in {"driveway", "alley", "building"} and site["origin_source_id"], "origin source missing")
    require(site["sidewalk_continuation_across_origin"] is True and site["sidewalk_continuation_source_id"], "sidewalk continuation source missing")
    require(site["sidewalk_boundary_source_id"] and site["rider_class_source_id"], "boundary or rider-class source missing")
    require(site["rider_class"] in {"bicycle", "electric_bicycle", "electric_scooter"}, "rider class outside ordinance")
    frames = packet["frames"]
    require(len(frames) >= 600, "recording shorter than 30 seconds")
    require(all(f["frame"] == i and abs(f["t_s"] - i / 20) < 1e-8 for i, f in enumerate(frames)), "noncontiguous 20 Hz frames")
    require(all(f["rider_id"] == packet["rider_id"] and f["pedestrian_id"] == packet["pedestrian_id"] for f in frames), "participant identity changed")
    require(all(f["rider_speed_mps"] >= 0 and isinstance(f["pedestrian_on_crossing"], bool) for f in frames), "motion or pedestrian source missing")
    entry = next((i for i, f in enumerate(frames) if f["rider_s_m"] >= 0), None)
    require(entry is not None and entry > 0 and frames[entry - 1]["rider_s_m"] < 0, "sidewalk entry missing")
    stop = [f["frame"] for f in frames[:entry] if f["rider_speed_mps"] <= 0.1 and f["rider_s_m"] < 0]
    ped_before_entry = [f["frame"] for f in frames[:entry] if f["pedestrian_on_crossing"]]
    ped_at_entry = frames[entry]["pedestrian_on_crossing"]
    return {"format": "c213851-saved-sidewalk-diagnostic-v1", "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT,
            "source_kind": kind, "frame_sha256": digest(frame_bytes), "site_sha256": digest(site_bytes),
            "frame_count": len(frames), "duration_s": len(frames) / 20,
            "district": site["district"], "origin_kind": site["origin_kind"],
            "rider_class": site["rider_class"], "sidewalk_entry_frame": entry,
            "pre_entry_near_zero_frames": stop, "pedestrian_on_crossing_before_entry_frames": ped_before_entry,
            "pedestrian_on_crossing_at_entry": ped_at_entry,
            "legal_result": None,
            "unresolved": ["physical sidewalk continuation", "rider classification", "pedestrian collision necessity", "stop immediacy", "physical source validity"]}
